title: AMINA: The Inclusive and Accountable AI for Marginalized Immigrant Nonprofit Assistance
reasoning: The paper presents an HCI/CSCW study on designing an inclusive AI assistant (AMINA) for marginalized immigrant nonprofits. It focuses on cooperative work, operational needs, misinformation mitigation, and alternative organizing, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, theology, ethics, or moral reasoning in LLMs.
